reason: Cutting the marked drum wall seems like a practical first step toward making the viewing openings.
expectation: I expect the scissors to cut openings or shape the strip for the drum, though the exact cuts are unclear.

alternatives.reason: The spindle and base should help the drum turn, but I chose to prepare the wall first.

effect: The strip now has viewing slits, so it is ready to be formed into a wall.
reaction: The result matches the expected purpose of the cuts.
reason: Taping the slit wall should form the drum.
expectation: I expect the tape to join the strip into a cylindrical wall.

alternatives.reason: The turning platform is also needed, but I want to finish forming the wall first.

effect: The wall is now a cylinder, ready for its floor.
reaction: The taped cylinder was the expected result.
reason: Adding the floor should complete the drum before mounting it.
expectation: I expect the round floor to attach to the slotted cylinder.

alternatives.reason: The turning base also needs assembly, but I chose to finish the drum first.

effect: The drum now has a floor, leaving the turning base to assemble.
reason: This is the only offered combination, and the spindle should let the drum turn.
expectation: I expect a base with a turning platform ready to support the drum.

effect: The turntable is ready to support the completed drum.
reaction: The base came together as expected.
reason: This is the only offered combination, and mounting the drum should let it turn.
expectation: I expect the drum to sit on the turntable and rotate, though I don't yet know how it will be tested.

effect: Mounting the drum completed the goal: it turns on the axle while its base stays still, and the slits pass the viewer’s eye. The picture show itself remains empty.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the parts work together, though I am curious how the slits will make the pictures move.

mostWorthwhile.text: Mounting and testing the drum brought the construction together and showed how its turning platform and viewing slits work.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the floor was straightforward but gave little insight beyond fitting the next part.

surprise.text: The twelve windows passing the eye suggest how the picture show might work, although the result does not yet explain the animation.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; each part had a clear role in making or supporting the drum.

continue.text: Yes. I would like to see how the empty drum becomes a moving picture show and whether the mechanism is explained.
